summary: The round 1 fixes do what each finding asked. CONTRIBUTING.md now points "Template version" at docs/contract.md, which has that heading, and names 2.1.316 for `claude plugin tag`. The guard timing now says 78 seconds was the whole baseline. The repeated background sentence and the bold lead-ins are gone. docs/scripts.md and the bash-conventions standard no longer say that every script prints JSON. The R1-4 change follows the author's decision: docs/running.md, docs/setup.md and the review-only summary in skills/redline/SKILL.md now give the same instructions. They say the precheck stops while HEAD is ahead of the PR, using the skill's real line `pull or push so HEAD matches the PR`, that the person should copy the spec folder out and then run `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`, and that the next run starts at round 1. Every cross-reference these edits add resolves to an existing heading, and the diff touches no scheduled or queued work.
